title: Normalized integral shift witnesses and square compatibility
statement:
theorem automorphismConstructibleStage_integral_shift_witness
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (C : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (eX : Aut X) (eY : Aut Y)
    (h : eY.hom ≫ f = f ≫ eX.hom)
    (b : constructibleIntegralPullback l E f ⋙
      constructibleIntegralPullback l E eY.hom ≅
      constructibleIntegralPullback l E eX.hom ⋙
        constructibleIntegralPullback l E f)
    (hb : ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (b.hom.app K).hom =
        (integralComparisonComposition l E C eY.hom f K).inv ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun g ↦ (integralDerivedPullback l E g).obj K.obj) h) ≫
          (integralComparisonComposition l E C f eX.hom K).hom) :
    ∃ (cf : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).CommShift ℤ)
      (cX : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eX.hom).CommShift ℤ)
      (cY : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eY.hom).CommShift ℤ),
      (∃ (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E f).CommShift ℤ)
        (d : (integralDerivedPullback l E f).CommShift ℤ),
        IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E f c ∧
          IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E f c d ∧
          ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (r : ℤ),
            HEq (((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).commShiftIso
              (self := cf) r).hom.app K).hom
              (((integralDerivedPullback l E f).commShiftIso r).hom.app K.obj)) ∧
      (∃ (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E eX.hom).CommShift ℤ)
        (d : (integralDerivedPullback l E eX.hom).CommShift ℤ),
        IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E eX.hom c ∧
          IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E eX.hom c d ∧
          ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (r : ℤ),
            HEq (((constructibleIntegralPullback l E eX.hom).commShiftIso
              (self := cX) r).hom.app K).hom
              (((integralDerivedPullback l E eX.hom).commShiftIso r).hom.app K.obj)) ∧
      (∃ (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E eY.hom).CommShift ℤ)
        (d : (integralDerivedPullback l E eY.hom).CommShift ℤ),
        IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E eY.hom c ∧
          IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E eY.hom c d ∧
          ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (r : ℤ),
            HEq (((constructibleIntegralPullback l E eY.hom).commShiftIso
              (self := cY) r).hom.app K).hom
              (((integralDerivedPullback l E eY.hom).commShiftIso r).hom.app K.obj)) ∧
      (fun [sf : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).CommShift ℤ]
        [sX : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eX.hom).CommShift ℤ]
        [sY : (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eY.hom).CommShift ℤ] ↦
        (constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).IsTriangulated ∧
          (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eX.hom).IsTriangulated ∧
          (constructibleIntegralPullback l E eY.hom).IsTriangulated ∧
          NatTrans.CommShift b.hom ℤ)
        (sf := cf) (sX := cX) (sY := cY)

proof.text: Choose a family of normalized cochain shifts and their derived descents using automorphismConstructibleStage_integral_shift_data. Restrict each derived shift through the fully faithful constructible inclusion using Functor.CommShift.ofComp. Its compatibility formula identifies the underlying shift component with the derived component, giving all three normalization witnesses.

Equip the coefficient-system limit with its canonical exact shift and reduction with the adjoint-mate shift. The limit is triangulated by its derived restriction and constant-tower-limit construction; reduction is triangulated by the adjunction, and sequence pullback is triangulated as the derived functor of an exact functor. The normalized realization isomorphism commutes with shifts, so integral derived pullback and then its full constructible restriction are triangulated.

For a composable pair construct the prescribed composition comparison on the constructible category. First whisker the normalized realization with reduction and compose with the adjunction counit. This is shift compatible; its restriction is invertible by the effectiveness field of IntegralComparisonSystem. Paste its inverse, the realization isomorphisms, and the derived sequence composition isomorphism to form the normalized composition comparison. Derived exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism compatibility give shift compatibility of the sequence comparison. All associators and whiskerings commute with shifts. Reflect compatibility through the faithful constructible inclusion, and check componentwise that the pasted isomorphism is integralComparisonComposition.

Apply the composition construction to (eY.hom,f) and (f,eX.hom). The coherent family of chosen shifts makes equality transport along h shift compatible by equality induction. Compose the inverse of the first comparison, equality transport, and the second comparison. Its component is exactly the component specified in hb, so faithful inclusion and natural transformation extensionality identify it with b. It therefore commutes with shifts.
